read.thesis: Tenet beat Q1 on hospital and USPI margins with cost flexing, reaffirmed FY26 EBITDA guide (+10% normalised) without raising it, and bought back $318M of stock; exchange volumes down ~10%, still tracking the ~20% full-year assumption.

triggers.label: FY26 guide reaffirmed, not raised
triggers.quote: we are not making any adjustments to our full-year 2026 outlook at this time

triggers.label: Capital deployed to USPI M&A: $125M Q1
triggers.quote: investing $125 million in the first quarter to acquire seven ASCs

triggers.label: Exchange admissions down ~10% in Q1
triggers.quote: same-store exchange admissions down about 10% compared to first quarter 2025, but not yet at the level we assumed

guidance.quote: our 2026 adjusted EBITDA is expected to grow at 10% at the midpoint of our range

guidance.metric: FY26 adjusted free cash flow after NCI
guidance.quote: we continue to expect adjusted free cash flow after NCI in the range of $1.6 billion to $1.83 billion

guidance.metric: Q2 adjusted EBITDA share of FY
guidance.quote: For Q2, we expect consolidated adjusted EBITDA to be 24% to 25% of our full-year consolidated adjusted EBITDA at the midpoint
our guidance range of a 20% reduction and $250 million overall impact is still pretty consistent
our $250 million annual target for USPI M&A

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are reaffirming the full-year 2026 guidance that we initially provided in February
We are executing on the expense initiatives that we discussed on our fourth quarter 2025 earnings call and are recognizing the benefits
our guidance range of a 20% reduction and $250 million overall impact is still pretty consistent

red_flags.label: Payer denials and disputes 'too high'
red_flags.quote: they are high, they have been too high, but we do not see a meaningful trend this quarter that is different

red_flags.label: Uncompensated care rising
red_flags.quote: We can only guess, obviously, with the slight increase in uncompensated care

evasions.topic: Hospital margin bridge for rest of year
evasions.quote: I do not know that the algorithm is exactly like it would be in a normal year.

evasions.topic: Exchange uninsured trend and guidance fit
evasions.quote: I think we should watch and wait.
